name: Shrewd Negotiations
summary: After your infiltration of the mages' city, Magus Wordeen Voidglare sends you to Dalaran. Carry the arcane mote to Archmage Celindra; Wordeen believes the Kirin Tor will give anything to recover it.

sections.title: Time to Negotiate
sections.body: Magus Wordeen Voidglare says no order on Azeroth matches the Kirin Tor in arcane knowledge. Even his brilliant work pales beside their ancient wisdom. He believes the Horde should gain access to their exclusive order. So he sends you to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran with the mote you acquired. Wordeen believes the Kirin Tor will give anything to get it back.

faq.q: Who sends you to negotiate with Dalaran?
faq.answer: Magus Wordeen Voidglare sends you to Dalaran after your infiltration of the city.

faq.q: Who are you sent to speak with?
faq.answer: You are sent to speak with Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.
You carry the arcane mote you acquired. Wordeen believes the Kirin Tor will give anything to recover it.

faq.q: Why does Wordeen Voidglare want to deal with Dalaran?
faq.answer: Wordeen says no place on Azeroth rivals the Kirin Tor in arcane knowledge. He believes the Horde should gain access to their exclusive order.
